title: Register vector of a state
statement: For each machine state, its register vector is the vector of length $18$ whose entries, in order, are the input-length counter, the base, the exponent counter, the power accumulator, the two scratch registers, the loop counter, the window radius, the code width, the code bound, the source code, the target code, the midpoint, the level, the saved-endpoints stack, the phase-bit stack, the last popped endpoint, and the pop-routine scratch register.
